supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The brow ridge extends laterally beyond the outer ocular canthi by a width approximately equal to one ocular diameter on each side.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast; the muzzle region exhibits significantly higher pixel intensity (lighter grey) compared to the dark-pigmented periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: The lower lip exhibits moderate vertical thickness with a distinct white mucosal line visible at the margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of light-colored/grey hair on the chin area.
